// deckProfile.archetype 枚举值: burst | grind | ramp | control | swarm | hybrid
// deckProfile.startupSpeed 枚举值: turn1 (≤1费启动) | turn2 (2费启动) | turn3 (≥3费启动)
// keyCard.role 枚举值: combo_starter | combo_finisher | draw | sustain | disruption | ramp
// keyCard.importance 枚举值: core (不可替代) | important (显著削弱) | flexible (可替代)
// comboLine.damageType 枚举值: vaporize | melt | overload | electrocharge | freeze | superconduct | swirl | burning | bloom | aggravate | spread | raw | other
// comboLine.expectedRound: 基于步骤总费用推算的触发回合 (1-6)
// opponentThreat.kind 枚举值: lethal (2回合≥6伤害) | disrupting (控制行动) | grinding (消耗) | ramping (积累资源)
// opponentThreat.window 枚举值: early (1-2回合) | mid (3-4回合) | late (5回合+)
// abstentions: 标注者无可靠依据时应弃权，不要编造
